_comment: Leg manifest for harness/orchestrate.ps1. Adding a leg is DATA, not a new dispatcher script. The orchestrator owns: dependency gating, worktree creation, trust, launch, receipt monitoring, branch backup, and notification - in ONE window. Supersedes run_relay.ps1, run_solaris_repair.ps1, run_repair_heats.ps1, run_followon.ps1, heartbeat.ps1 and watch_relay.ps1.
_effort_note: VERIFIED 2026-07-26 by negative control: 'claude --effort banana' warns 'Unknown --effort value, ignoring it' and lists low/medium/high/xhigh/max. 'ultracode' produces NO warning, so it is recognised despite being absent from --help. Acceptance alone would have proved nothing - a silently-ignored flag returns OK exactly like an applied one.

legs.name: h22 compat
legs.note: R59. dir() says a symbol EXISTS; it cannot say DEPRECATED. Cross-references every hou.* SYNAPSE touches against the H22 reference and classifies it OK / DECAY_CLOCK / PRIVATE_API / PHANTOM. karmarenderproperties is deprecated and emitted in 11+ places while every live probe reported it healthy. Read-only, disjoint from H1/H2, gated on nothing.

legs.name: substrate truth
legs.note: R64. moneta_available() is one boolean carrying five independent claims: imports / same-module-both-interpreters / schema registered / prims authored typed / round-trips. Only the first is measured. MonetaMemory is concreteTyped and codegen'd, but the brief says prims are still untyped def - expected live state is registered=True in_use=False, the only cell that looks like success. Writes moneta_runtime.py so NOT read-only.

legs.name: compat re-adjudicate
legs.note: R72. H5 returned UNVERIFIABLE:1267 - partly a REACHABILITY artifact, since the pinned docs tree is ROBOTS_DISALLOWED and the unpinned one serves 21.0. Two local version-pinned sources exist: hom.zip (HOM axis, authoritative, control-passed) and the help cache (node axis, second source only). Adds the doc_silent_deprecation cell: runtime deprecated, authored help silent - karmarenderproperties and karma are its first members. deps H6 so nothing running is interrupted.

legs.name: integrate
legs.note: merge, housekeep, prune worktrees. Runs LAST - gated on every evidence-producing leg so integration never merges a picture that is still moving.
